name: Loja (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided purple over white, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Loja (an oval shield with a castle and a bridge above waves, surrounded by the collar of the Golden Fleece).
history: The flag of Loja was made official together with the historic arms on 20 July 2005; it is a rectangular flag parted into two horizontal stripes, purple above and white below, with the municipal arms at the centre over both stripes.

features.role: Loja arms — oval shield with castle and bridge, surrounded by the collar of the Golden Fleece
